method.sources: committed git blobs only; worktree product content ignored
method.dependency_scope: all booking_app Python files; AST import graph with static relative-import resolution; external libraries excluded from SCC
method.sql_scope: AST attribute calls named execute/executemany/executescript/commit/rollback in booking_app; lexical call-site evidence, not dynamic execution
method.size_scope: tracked booking_app/scripts/tests .py/.js/.cjs/.html/.css/.sql; physical lines and UTF-8 bytes; evidence and framework excluded
method.function_scope: all Python function/method AST spans in booking_app (nested included); physical span and AST statement counts
method.duplication_scope: exact Python function bodies >=4 AST statements after removing docstring, ignores location; semantic/JS duplication requires manual review
limitations: Import edges are static; dynamic imports/runtime injection and JS dependency graphs are not inferred.
SQL call counts are lexical, not SQL-statement counts or a proof of runtime behavior.
Line spans can hide compressed multi-statement JavaScript; inspect byte size and responsibilities.
Range includes interleaved Story 2.5, experiment/recording work and historical runner corrections; no exclusive Epic 3 attribution.
No runtime tests are executed by this derivation; acceptance and process causality are out of scope.
